viewport-inset.$description: Margin kept between a fixed, centred panel and the screen edge. The recipe composes it as max-h-[calc(100dvh-var(...))]: the INSET is the design measurement and lives here; 100dvh is the viewport, not a token. Without the bound the panel grows past both viewport edges and its content is unreachable at 320px and at 200% zoom, because the page scrollbar cannot reach a fixed element.

size.$description: Hit area of the close control — 24px box around a 16px glyph. The recipe floors it with max(…, --target-floor), so under a coarse pointer the BOX grows to 44px while the glyph stays put.
